title: Read a participle chain
subtitle: Keep the main verb standing while participles add detail.
overview: A participle chain can surround a single main verb with circumstances. Identify the finite verb first, then parse each participle by agreement, tense-form, and voice.
Only afterward decide whether English needs “when,” “because,” “although,” “having …,” or a simple coordinated verb.

items.en: Having seen their faith, he spoke.
Having come to him, he was seeking him.
